Specifically, make the acceptance dependent on comparing the dessert quantity from PF1 (48 desserts) against the cash value in PF2 ($360), and make the delivery details (C4) and allergy requirements (C5, C6) mandatory components of the 'arrangement_accepted' decision so that a model cannot accept the deal without knowing the specific venue entrance (PF3) or the sesame-free requirement (PF4).
